content:
maria: FYI staging promote is failing on the final artifact upload. CI shows truncated blob and checksum mismatch. Can someone take a look?

josh: gah. link to job?

maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/jobs/4872 — logs in build/artifact-upload. error: "unexpected EOF while reading tar" and then "checksum mismatch for layers/abcd1234"

vince: deploybot is still trying to promote the canary, sees the artifact as uploaded but the registry returns 400 on extract. here's the deploybot snippet:
```
deploybot: promote canary 2023-11-02T16:33:09Z -> status: uploading
deploybot: upload returned 200 but verify failed: digest != expected
```

anika: is this the same layer drift we saw last week? if so we should pin to last-known-good (tag: release-20231102-v2) and abort the running promote. manual promote after reupload.

maria: pin sounds safe. question: can we reupload the artifact quickly or do we need to rebuild?

josh: the build finished fine earlier, but the upload step appears to have truncated due to a multipart upload retry race. reupload should work if we re-run just the push stage. i'll trigger a re-push job.

sre-bot: noticed increased 5xxs from registry-west during the time window 16:32-16:35 UTC. request id: r-9f3c. Could be network-induced corruption.

vince: deploybot currently has a queued promote, it won't auto-fallback. if we let it continue it may mark the canary as promoted with a bad manifest. recommend canceling the promote job now.

maria: @deploybot cancel promote 4872

deploybot: cancel request received for promote 4872. stopping after current upload chunk. status: cancelling

anika: plan: 1) cancel promote 2) pin service to release-20231102-v2 (last-good) 3) re-run push job for artifact 4) smoke canary in staging 5) resume promote in next change window (or manual)

linda: change window check — we have a 2-hour window starting 17:00 UTC. approve manual resume in-window. for now pin and unblock downstream. :thumbsup: 

josh: kicked off re-push job (job 4873). logs: started multipart upload, part 1/6 ok. I'll watch.

maria: i'm going to update the release notes with an incident note and add a blocking tag so we don't auto-promote while this is unresolved.

vince: after reupload we should run `skopeo inspect` locally to validate digests before telling deploybot to resume. command: `skopeo inspect --raw docker://registry/internal/release-20231102-v3 | jq -r .`

anika: agreed. also add a short postmortem TODO to check registry multipart retry idempotency.

josh: re-push finished — all parts reported ok and registry verify passed. digest now matches expected: sha256:abcd1234ffff.

sre-bot: registry-west 5xxs back to normal. median upload latency improved.

vince: I validated with skopeo, digests match. ready to resume promote but per linda we'll wait for change window.

maria: locking the auto-promo flag on the release until window. created ticket REL-3321 and updated release notes: "staging upload transient failure, pinned to previous artifact pending safe re-promote in change window"

linda: thanks everyone. we'll resume at 17:05 UTC with manual promote and monitor closely. keep the rollback plan ready: pin back to release-20231102-v2 if anything flakes.

josh: note for follow-up: add checksum verification step to CI after upload so deploybot sees verified manifest before mark-success. filing a small follow-up PR.

maria: ok, closing thread for now. will post when promote resumes. :white_check_mark:
